notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Work In Progress

Play with Friends

 We're continuing to work on the friend invite system, allowing you to easily team up and enjoy matches together with your friends. Get ready for a more connected and fun multiplayer experience!


New Game Mode – Story Mode

 Development has begun on a brand-new Story Mode, where you'll finally be able to uncover the secrets of the world we've built for you.
Explore the lore, face unique challenges, and dive deeper into the universe of the game.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Changelog

Gameplay – New Map & Mode Enhancements

 Improved Bot Logic: Bots now engage with each other instead of focusing solely on the player, adding more depth and unpredictability to each match.
 Loot Drop Management: Adjusted crate drop mechanics and spawn positions for better balance and strategic opportunities across the new map.


Work In Progress

 We're working on implementing Steam friend invites, so you can easily team up and play with your friends.
 New game modes are also in development — stay tuned for more variety and challenges in the near future!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Changelog

Gameplay

 New Map & Game Mode Introduced!
Challenge yourself in an all-new map where your objective is to reach the end while battling other players and escaping a deadly storm. VERTICAL ROYAL IS HERE!
Only the strongest and smartest will survive this intense, high-pressure race to the finish.


User Interface

 Various UI fixes have been implemented to enhance player experience and visual consistency.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Changelog

UI & Visuals

 Minor UI fixes to improve clarity and user experience.
 Bot appearance updated –  new and varied aesthetics.


Matchmaking

 Improved matchmaking system and feedback messages during search phases for better user understanding.


Gameplay Systems

 Introduced the experience (EXP) gain mechanic, laying the groundwork for future player progression systems.
 Spectator mode temporarily removed due to bugs – we’re actively working on fixing the issues.


Work In Progress

 We are actively working on implementing a friend invite system to let you team up and play together more easily. Stay tuned!

notes.notes:
Changelog

Survival Mode & Bots

 Optimized Survival Mode for smoother performance and stability.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Tutorial Improvements: The onboarding experience has been refined to better guide new players through the core mechanics of Fast Royal.

Smarter Bots: We’ve updated bot behavior to be more challenging and realistic, with balanced damage and health adjustments to better match player performance.

Faster Matchmaking: Matchmaking times have been reduced, getting you into the action quicker than ever.

UI Enhancements: Various visual and functional updates to the interface for a smoother and more intuitive experience.

Gameplay Fixes: Several bugs affecting combat, movement, and overall gameplay responsiveness have been resolved.

A huge thank-you to our Game Tester team for their continued feedback and support. Your insights are helping shape Fast Royal into an even better experience.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Changelog

Abilities & Classes

[] Warrior Class: Added Grenade Ability.
[] Tank Class: Added Shield Ability.
[] Assassin Class: Added Dash Ability.
[] Fixed ability cost for all abilities.


Gameplay Enhancements

[] Healing drones now spawn and drop health.
[] Improved HUD for better readability and user experience.
 Created Ping Widget for better communication.


Balancing & Improvements

[] Adjusted weapon balance across all classes.
[] Refined character ability balance for smoother gameplay.
 Fixed weapon replication issues.


Visual & Effects

[] Fixed VFX disappearance issues.
[] Improved appearing/disappearing weapon VFX.
[] Implemented VFX for Power-Up activation on characters.
[] Added new VFX for various characters and weapons.


Thanks
A heartfelt thank you to all the players who participated in our tests, providing invaluable feedback that helped us refine the game.

A special thanks to GameTester for their professionalism and dedication throughout the testing process.

Finally, we want to express our deepest gratitude to our friends and family, who have supported us from the very beginning of development. Your encouragement and belief in our project have been essential in bringing this game to life.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
Changelog

Input Controller

    The game now supports input controllers.


Tutorial

    Fixed the tutorial message issue.
    Introduced a tutorial on the first join.


Gameplay

    Shield added.
    Bot added in the tutorial.
    Balanced damage, fire rate, number of projectiles, and health for various classes.
    Optimized class agility.


Audio & Effects

    Activated chest sound.
    Improved zoom ability for better accuracy.


Bonus & Game Modes

    Drone now drops health.
    Prizes awarded to the leaderboard winner.
    Prize modified based on position in Royal Mode.


Settings

    Added keyboard and mouse input action to settings.


Thanks
A special thanks to all the testers who actively contributed to improving the game.  
Your passion, attention to detail, and valuable feedback have helped us create a  
better and more balanced version. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Major Update: Tutorials, Weapon Balance & Character Adjustments!
notes.notes:
We’re continuously improving the game based on player feedback! Here’s what’s new in this update:


  Enhanced tutorials to help new players learn faster
  Weapon balancing for a more fair and competitive experience
  Character ability adjustments to ensure a smoother gameplay


Jump in and experience the improvements firsthand!
